title: REQUEST:  an additional widget that uses a much larger font
body:
My wife follows my bg on my old phone, a Note 2.  The widget is on it's on home page, maximized to cover the full screen.  However, the font doesn't enlarge when the widget size is increased.   Could you make another widget option with a larger font....oh no!  I just this second realized that if you add a widget, that means I'd need a new version of xdrip and none of them work with my Gear 2 watch except up to, and including the 7/15/18 version.    aack!    Well, if you can fix the Android Notifications issue that cropped up sometime after the 7/15 version, I could then install a new version with the requested widget as a new feature.  thanks (in advance)

![20190115_071358](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/37376075/51190680-a0e4fa80-1897-11e9-953a-528103b42c82.jpg)

comments.body: and I wouldn't mind if a second widget did away with the graph, as long as it uses a much larger font for the number.
any chance of getting a widget with a very large font?

U CAN use number Wall on lock screen 
There u can chose how Big, colour and where in lock you Shows your BG 
Also You can see a Trend arrow if u want
that phone is running android 4.3.  I don't think that it's possible to do as u suggest.
I'd still love to have bigger text on a widget...

Looks like there is an alternative (Number wall) that works only on Android 7 and above.
Unfortunately, adding new features for older technology is not going to be easy.
Closing due to inactivity

xDrip no longer supports Android 4.
As of June 15, 2023, xDrip does not support Android 5 either.
Currently, Android 6 is the older version of Android supported by xDrip.

I am closing this issue because it seems there is an alternative that supports larger font.
